lore: You put a hand on it. It is older than your whole family tree, put together.
The real thing is the Bridestones, near Congleton, on the Cheshire and Staffordshire border: a Neolithic burial chamber that has lost most of its mound.

pois.line: A hollow in the old tree, and something wrapped in oilcloth.

lore: The wind drops when you stand beside it. You do not mention this to anyone.

pois.line: The lamping's good here. Was good here.
A flask-sized tin under a flat stone, tied with garden twine.
